title: Observe Gemini physical-call usage with server-only cost telemetry
purpose: 会話や記憶・関係性を扱う処理の変更
purpose_basis: 変更パスと表題による分類（意味の確定には原文を確認）
body:
Geminiの実使用量を物理API attemptごとに観測し、Free 20 / Premium 50の将来の原価判断に使える事実を保存します。観測専用です。Relationship v1.1、♥、Stage、会話品質、quotaへusageを返す経路はありません。Draftのまま、mergeしないでください。

正本仕様は `docs/GEMINI_UNIT_COST_TELEMETRY_WORK_HANDOFF.md` を commit `ed8359319181f20cf73aec87ab75c7a1405264f2`（`docs/relationship-v1-2-stage-growth-principles`）から読了しました。作業開始時にmainには未収録だったため、実装はmain `465075ce07c3b2129de51b14f790c54154521c49` から分離しています。

## 実装・retry計測
- `normal_reply`: 通常チャット。server認証済みuser IDと既存の検証済みrequest IDを使用。
- `relationship_analyzer` / `critical_validator`: permanent・anonymous・temporary importの既存canonical経路へoptional sinkを接続。
- usageMetadataのprompt/candidates/thoughts/total/cached countsをそのままnormalize。欠落・不正値はNULL、providerが明示した0だけ0。totalの再計算・料金/為替の固定保存はしません。
- 物理fetchごとにattempt_noを加算。429/502/503/504、timeout、network errorを独立行で記録。attempt_noはgenerator invocationごとに1から開始し、application-level再生成も追加行です。request_idで全物理callを集計できます。
- 捨てていたretryレスポンスはcloneから非同期でusageだけ抽出（2秒・100万文字上限）。読み取りを待たず元のretry delayへ進みます。取得不能ならNULL。network/abortの課金推測はしません。
- successはHTTP Response.okです。内容のparse成功・Relationship成立・会話完了とは別です。latencyはfetch開始→HTTP headers/transport rejection、occurred_atはattempt開始。modelは既存のrequested model。

## DB変更・適用状況
`public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry` を追加。id、nullable user_id/request_id、call_kind/model/attempt_no、nullable token counts/http_status/latency_ms、success、occurred_atのみ。
RLS有効。PUBLIC/anon/authenticatedの全権限をrevoke、service_roleへSELECT/INSERTのみgrant、service専用policy。クライアント書込経路なし。Relationship/quotaへのFK・trigger・RPC・SECURITY DEFINERはありません。日時・user/date・request集計用索引3本。

Misaki Supabase `tzozajnwznxqgxnjikoy` へ独立した追加DDLのみ適用済み（version `20261004045307`）。CLIのmigration newで生成後、remote履歴のversionへfilenameを整合し二重適用を防止。アプリのmerge・Production deploy・START_AT変更はしていません。

## telemetry失敗時
server-only sinkがNext after()を即時登録し、DB書込はresponse後（既存Relationship after内からも登録可能）。Gemini・retry判断・leaseは保存をawaitしません。DB transportは2秒timeout。登録/書込失敗でも結果・返答・retry・Relationship処理を変更せず、ログは固定文字列 `GEMINI TELEMETRY WRITE FAILED` のみ。throw内容やDB/providerエラー本文を出しません。best-effortなので観測欠損はあり得ます。

## 保存しない情報・変更しない契約
payloadは明示allowlist。ユーザー会話、美咲返答、system prompt、memory、Evidence/supportingTurn、Gemini raw response、API key、価格・通貨・為替を保存しません。
model、prompt、generationConfig、Analyzer schema/polarity/parseEvidence、Episode/Pattern、lease/retry回数・delay、critical契約、acting guide、START_AT、Stage、Free 20/Premium 50 runtimeは変更なし。
proactive_reply/body_clock/image_generationは分類予約のみ。Body Clock・proactive・image runtimeは未変更。

## 変更ファイル
- `app/api/chat/route.ts`
- `lib/gemini-json-generator.ts`
- `lib/gemini-usage-telemetry.ts`
- `lib/gemini-usage-telemetry-server.ts`
- `lib/relationship-analyzer-v1.ts`
- `lib/relationship-runtime-v1.ts`
- `supabase/migrations/20261004045307_gemini_usage_telemetry.sql`
- `tests/gemini-usage-telemetry.test.ts`
- `tests/gemini-usage-telemetry-server.test.cjs`
- `tests/gemini-usage-telemetry.rollback.sql`
- `tests/server-canonical.test.cjs` / `tests/relationship-runtime-v1.test.cjs`（既存VM harnessに新server境界・performanceのmock追加）
- `docs/GEMINI_USAGE_TELEMETRY.md`
- `package.json` / `package-lock.json`（server-only 0.0.1をpin、既存dependency version維持）
- `.github/workflows/canonical-relationship-integration-tests.yml`（この隔離branchのpushでPR前CIを実行、明示tsc追加）

## 検証・CI
- Local: `TZ=Asia/Tokyo npm test` **262/262成功**。追加9テストはnormalization、unknown/zero、各retry/timeout/network attempt、error usage、hung retry body、sink throw/reject/hang、storage allowlist、server after write failure、3分類、Analyzer/validator既存結果維持を確認。
- Local: `npx tsc --noEmit` 成功、`npm run build` 成功。既存CRLFを維持して `git -c core.whitespace=cr-at-eol diff origin/main --check` 成功。
- 作業環境の初回America/New_Yorkでは既存生活記憶テストのlocal-day条件が失敗。該当runtime/testは変更せず、日本時間で全件成功。GitHub標準runnerでも全件成功。
- Supabase: `tests/gemini-usage-telemetry.rollback.sql` をBEGIN/ROLLBACKで実行成功。service書込/読取、別attempt行、NULL default、anon/authenticated SELECT/INSERT拒否を確認。RLS=true、PUBLIC revoked=true、anon/authenticated access=false、service SELECT/INSERT=true。合成行は残していません。
- **PR作成前 GitHub CI #341成功**: [workflow run](https://github.com/miyazaki1016/misaki/actions/runs/37178512759)。npm ci / 全テスト / TypeScript / production build成功。commit `c4bc326e1d95e047a4a3a7bd072aebd4ff96669e`。remote treeはlocal検証treeと一致（`9f55262ffdd71204bb3c1e1b8c5614f5ecf80ca7`）。

## Supabase advisor結果
DDL前後のsecurity/performanceを確認。
- Security: **新テーブルの指摘なし**。既存のRLS no-policy INFO、authenticated SECURITY DEFINER/anonymous policy/password protection WARNは変化なし。
- Performance: 新テーブルは収集開始前の索引3本についてのみ unused_index INFO。既存WARNは変化なし。意図した分析用索引を維持し、収集後に利用実績を再確認します。[unused-index advisor](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/database-linter?lint=0005_unused_index)。


## Identity semantics（レビュー修正済み）
`user_id` はGemini call発生時のserver検証済みauth user UUIDです。anonymous authenticated user UUIDも含み、恒久アカウント・課金アカウントIDとは限りません。このfield単独（有無を含む）でFree/Premiumを判定してはいけません。将来、匿名→恒久のidentity遷移を考慮し、canonical account / subscription情報と安全にjoinし、occurred_at時点のsubscription状態からcohortを判定します。mappingが解決できない場合はunknownとします。
documentationとコードコメントのみ3ファイルを修正。DB schema変更・DDL・課金/planロジック追加なし。コメント除去後のTypeScript transpile結果は変更前と同一です。

最新commit: `e329b6c81bce3f5f54a5a6d5af14c3ebc40d2035`。
再検証: local全262テスト / TypeScript / production build成功。

+# Gemini provider usage telemetry
+
+Observability only. Source handoff: `docs/GEMINI_UNIT_COST_TELEMETRY_WORK_HANDOFF.md`
+at commit `ed8359319181f20cf73aec87ab75c7a1405264f2` on
+`docs/relationship-v1-2-stage-growth-principles` (not yet on main when implemented).
+
+## Recorded facts
+
+Each physical `generateContent` attempt produces its own row in
+`public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry`, including transient retries, timeouts and
+network failures. `attempt_no` starts at 1 per generator invocation; a separate
+application-level generation/Relationship retry starts another invocation and
+produces additional rows, never an upsert/deduplication. Aggregate all rows for
+the same opaque `request_id` to include retries and analysis in turn cost.
+
+`model` is the requested model. `success` means HTTP `Response.ok`, not a parsed
+reply, confirmed Evidence/event or a completed billable user turn. A 200 response
+with malformed/blocked content can still have real provider usage. HTTP failures
+can also have usage. `latency_ms` measures fetch start to HTTP headers, or to
+transport rejection; it excludes retry sleep, body parsing and telemetry writes.
+`occurred_at` is the attempt start time.
+
+Counts map directly from `usageMetadata`: `promptTokenCount`,
+`candidatesTokenCount`, `thoughtsTokenCount`, `totalTokenCount`, and
+`cachedContentTokenCount`. Missing/invalid fields remain NULL; explicitly reported
+zero remains zero. Do not reconstruct totals, assume cache/thought counts are
+zero, or infer charges from network failure. Pricing and FX are separate future
+versioned calculation inputs. Usage does not establish a provider invoice by
+itself, and NULL rows must remain visible as coverage gaps in later cost reports.
+
+## Identity semantics and future cohort analysis
+
+`user_id` is the auth user UUID verified by the server for the context in which
+the Gemini call occurs. It is not necessarily a permanent account or billing
+account ID: anonymous authenticated user UUIDs are included. NULL means no
+verified identity was supplied; it does not identify a plan or cohort.
+
+Free / Premium cohort analysis must never infer a plan from `user_id` alone,
+including whether it is present. Future analysis must safely join the verified
+auth identity to canonical account and subscription information, accounting for
+anonymous-to-permanent identity transitions and the subscription state applicable
+at `occurred_at`. Unresolved identity or subscription mappings must remain unknown
+rather than being assigned a plan by assumption. This telemetry change implements
+no canonical-account mapping, subscription join, plan detection or billing logic.
+
+## Integration and failure isolation
+
+- Authenticated chat generation: `normal_reply`, server-verified user UUID and
+  existing validated request UUID (including anonymous authenticated users).
+- Permanent and anonymous canonical Relationship processing, including temporary
+  import: `relationship_analyzer` / `critical_validator`, verified owner and turn
+  request ID. Analyzer/validator accept an optional usage sink only; schemas,
+  prompts, parsing and return values are unchanged.
+- `proactive_reply`, `body_clock`, `image_generation` are reserved enum values;
+  none of those runtimes or acting-lab calls are instrumented by this change.
+
+The server-only sink registers a Next.js `after()` callback immediately. Inserts
+run after the response, also when nested inside existing Relationship `after()`
+work. No DB operation is awaited by Gemini, retry decisions, or a Relationship
+lease. Retry-body usage is read from a clone asynchronously, bounded to 2 seconds
+and 1 million characters; unreadable/late/oversized retry bodies yield NULL usage.
+Telemetry DB fetches have a 2-second timeout and no application write retries.
+Failed registration/insert emits only `GEMINI TELEMETRY WRITE FAILED`, never an
+exception payload. Failures lose observations without altering product behavior.
+This is best effort, not a durable accounting ledger.
+
+An explicit storage allowlist includes only usage, transport facts, classification
+and opaque correlation IDs. No message/reply, system prompt, memory,
+Evidence/supportingTurn, raw response, key, currency or price is passed to storage.
+
+## Database and verification
+
+Migration: `20261004045307_gemini_usage_telemetry.sql`. Initially generated via
+`supabase migration new`, then aligned with the version recorded by the remote
+Supabase migration API to prevent applying the same DDL twice.
+
+The independent table has no Relationship/quota foreign keys, triggers, RPCs or
+client write route. RLS is enabled; PUBLIC/anon/authenticated privileges revoked.
+Only service_role receives SELECT/INSERT; policies target that role exclusively.
+Indexes support time-range, user/time and request-level cost analysis.
+
+`tests/gemini-usage-telemetry.rollback.sql` checks service writes/reads, separate
+attempt rows, NULL defaults, forbidden anon/authenticated reads/writes and PUBLIC
+revocation in a transaction, leaving no synthetic data behind.
+
+2026-10-04 DDL/advisor verification on Misaki:
+
+- Security: no findings for the new table; existing findings were unchanged.
+- Performance: only three new unused-index INFO findings, expected before
+  collection/analysis starts. Keep these purposeful analysis indexes and review
+  after actual workload develops. [Advisor explanation](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/database-linter?lint=0005_unused_index).
+- No production application deployment or merge is part of this Draft PR. The
+  additive, empty server-only table is prepared; runtime collection starts only
+  after a separately reviewed deployment.

# Gemini provider usage telemetry

Observability only. Source handoff: `docs/GEMINI_UNIT_COST_TELEMETRY_WORK_HANDOFF.md`
at commit `ed8359319181f20cf73aec87ab75c7a1405264f2` on
`docs/relationship-v1-2-stage-growth-principles` (not yet on main when implemented).

## Recorded facts

Each physical `generateContent` attempt produces its own row in
`public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry`, including transient retries, timeouts and
network failures. `attempt_no` starts at 1 per generator invocation; a separate
application-level generation/Relationship retry starts another invocation and
produces additional rows, never an upsert/deduplication. Aggregate all rows for
the same opaque `request_id` to include retries and analysis in turn cost.

`model` is the requested model. `success` means HTTP `Response.ok`, not a parsed
reply, confirmed Evidence/event or a completed billable user turn. A 200 response
with malformed/blocked content can still have real provider usage. HTTP failures
can also have usage. `latency_ms` measures fetch start to HTTP headers, or to
transport rejection; it excludes retry sleep, body parsing and telemetry writes.
`occurred_at` is the attempt start time.

Counts map directly from `usageMetadata`: `promptTokenCount`,
`candidatesTokenCount`, `thoughtsTokenCount`, `totalTokenCount`, and
`cachedContentTokenCount`. Missing/invalid fields remain NULL; explicitly reported
zero remains zero. Do not reconstruct totals, assume cache/thought counts are
zero, or infer charges from network failure. Pricing and FX are separate future
versioned calculation inputs. Usage does not establish a provider invoice by
itself, and NULL rows must remain visible as coverage gaps in later cost reports.

## Identity semantics and future cohort analysis

`user_id` is the auth user UUID verified by the server for the context in which
the Gemini call occurs. It is not necessarily a permanent account or billing
account ID: anonymous authenticated user UUIDs are included. NULL means no
verified identity was supplied; it does not identify a plan or cohort.

Free / Premium cohort analysis must never infer a plan from `user_id` alone,
including whether it is present. Future analysis must safely join the verified
auth identity to canonical account and subscription information, accounting for
anonymous-to-permanent identity transitions and the subscription state applicable
at `occurred_at`. Unresolved identity or subscription mappings must remain unknown
rather than being assigned a plan by assumption. This telemetry change implements
no canonical-account mapping, subscription join, plan detection or billing logic.

## Integration and failure isolation

- Authenticated chat generation: `normal_reply`, server-verified user UUID and
  existing validated request UUID (including anonymous authenticated users).
- Permanent and anonymous canonical Relationship processing, including temporary
  import: `relationship_analyzer` / `critical_validator`, verified owner and turn
  request ID. Analyzer/validator accept an optional usage sink only; schemas,
  prompts, parsing and return values are unchanged.
- `proactive_reply`, `body_clock`, `image_generation` are reserved enum values;
  none of those runtimes or acting-lab calls are instrumented by this change.

The server-only sink registers a Next.js `after()` callback immediately. Inserts
run after the response, also when nested inside existing Relationship `after()`
work. No DB operation is awaited by Gemini, retry decisions, or a Relationship
lease. Retry-body usage is read from a clone asynchronously, bounded to 2 seconds
and 1 million characters; unreadable/late/oversized retry bodies yield NULL usage.
Telemetry DB fetches have a 2-second timeout and no application write retries.
Failed registration/insert emits only `GEMINI TELEMETRY WRITE FAILED`, never an
exception payload. Failures lose observations without altering product behavior.
This is best effort, not a durable accounting ledger.

An explicit storage allowlist includes only usage, transport facts, classification
and opaque correlation IDs. No message/reply, system prompt, memory,
Evidence/supportingTurn, raw response, key, currency or price is passed to storage.

## Database and verification

Migration: `20261004045307_gemini_usage_telemetry.sql`. Initially generated via
`supabase migration new`, then aligned with the version recorded by the remote
Supabase migration API to prevent applying the same DDL twice.

The independent table has no Relationship/quota foreign keys, triggers, RPCs or
client write route. RLS is enabled; PUBLIC/anon/authenticated privileges revoked.
Only service_role receives SELECT/INSERT; policies target that role exclusively.
Indexes support time-range, user/time and request-level cost analysis.

`tests/gemini-usage-telemetry.rollback.sql` checks service writes/reads, separate
attempt rows, NULL defaults, forbidden anon/authenticated reads/writes and PUBLIC
revocation in a transaction, leaving no synthetic data behind.

2026-10-04 DDL/advisor verification on Misaki:

- Security: no findings for the new table; existing findings were unchanged.
- Performance: only three new unused-index INFO findings, expected before
  collection/analysis starts. Keep these purposeful analysis indexes and review
  after actual workload develops. [Advisor explanation](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/database-linter?lint=0005_unused_index).
- No production application deployment or merge is part of this Draft PR. The
  additive, empty server-only table is prepared; runtime collection starts only
  after a separately reviewed deployment.

diff --git a/supabase/migrations/20261004045307_gemini_usage_telemetry.sql b/supabase/migrations/20261004045307_gemini_usage_telemetry.sql
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..28fd96f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/supabase/migrations/20261004045307_gemini_usage_telemetry.sql
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+-- Provider usage facts only; intentionally independent of relationship/quota tables.
+create table public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry (
+  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
+  user_id uuid,
+  request_id text check (request_id is null or length(request_id) <= 128),
+  call_kind text not null check (call_kind in ('normal_reply', 'relationship_analyzer', 'critical_validator',
+    'proactive_reply', 'body_clock', 'image_generation')),
+  model text not null,
+  attempt_no integer not null check (attempt_no > 0),
+  prompt_tokens bigint check (prompt_tokens >= 0),
+  candidate_tokens bigint check (candidate_tokens >= 0),
+  thoughts_tokens bigint check (thoughts_tokens >= 0),
+  total_tokens bigint check (total_tokens >= 0),
+  cached_tokens bigint check (cached_tokens >= 0),
+  http_status integer check (http_status between 100 and 599),
+  success boolean not null,
+  latency_ms bigint check (latency_ms >= 0),
+  occurred_at timestamptz not null default now()
+);
+alter table public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry enable row level security;
+revoke all on table public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry from public, anon, authenticated, service_role;
+grant select, insert on table public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry to service_role;
+-- Explicit service-only policies also make the intended access model visible to advisors.
+create policy gemini_usage_service_select on public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry
+  for select to service_role using (true);
+create policy gemini_usage_service_insert on public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry
+  for insert to service_role with check (true);
+create index gemini_usage_occurred_at_idx on public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry (occurred_at);
+create index gemini_usage_user_time_idx on public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry (user_id, occurred_at);
+create index gemini_usage_request_idx on public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry (request_id);
+comment on table public.misaki_gemini_usage_telemetry is
+  'Non-authoritative Gemini physical API attempt usage. NULL means unknown. No content, secrets, pricing or FX. No client access.';
